house.description: Browerville High School new gymnasium funding provided, bonds issued, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new gymnasium at Browerville High School; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+BROWERVILLE SCHOOL DISTRICT; GYMNASIUM. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+$7,800,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of education for a grant to Independent School District No. 787, Browerville, to predesign, design, engineer, and construct a new gymnasium at Browerville High School in the city of Browerville. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $7,800,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new gymnasium at Browerville High School; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. BROWERVILLE SCHOOL DISTRICT; GYMNASIUM.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$7,800,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of education for a grant to Independent School District No. 787, Browerville, to predesign, design, engineer, and construct a new gymnasium at Browerville High School in the city of Browerville.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $7,800,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $7,800,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of education for a grant to Independent School District No. 787, Browerville, to predesign, design, engineer, and construct a new gymnasium at Browerville High School in the city of Browerville.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $7,800,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
